notes.title: Miss Peacock：Build v0.9.0 Update Launched
Development Progress Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We sincerely thank you for your anticipation and ongoing attention to "Miss Peacock"! Your enthusiastic support is the driving force behind our continuous progress.

We are pleased to announce that we have successfully completed the alpha testing, which is an important milestone in the game development process. A special thanks to all the players who participated in this alpha test. Your feedback and suggestions have provided invaluable direction for the optimization and improvement of "Miss Peacock," making the game better because of you.

Moving forward, we plan to dedicate the next two months to optimizing and fixing the current version 0.9, aiming to bring you a smoother gameplay experience and more exquisite graphics.

Additionally, we will continue to develop version 1.0 based on the wishes and suggestions left by alpha test players in the wishing well, integrating more exciting content into the game.

While waiting requires some patience, please believe that we are giving our all to ensure that at the moment the game launches, we will bring you an unimaginable gaming feast. Please continue to look forward to the day when "Miss Peacock" officially meets you all!

Thank you once again for your support and affection. Let's all look forward to the wonderful presentation of "Miss Peacock"!

[Otter Club Games] [February 5, 2025]

notes.title: 《Miss Peacock》Inner test qualifications grant completenotice
notes.notes:
Dear Players:

Hello!

We are very pleased to announce that the release of Miss Peacock's closed beta qualification has been successfully completed.

In this closed beta qualification process, we received a lot of enthusiastic applications from players. After our rigorous screening and evaluation process, the list of players who have been qualified for the closed beta has been determined. These lucky players will be the first to experience the innovative and surprising content of Miss Peacock.

For players who have successfully qualified for the preview, please pay close attention to our official channels (official websites, official social media accounts, etc.), and we will provide detailed information about the preview as soon as possible, including download link, when the preview opens, and what to consider during the preview.

Players who failed to qualify for this closed beta should not be discouraged. "Miss Peacock" will open multiple rounds of testing in the future and gradually expand the scale of testing. We will continue to collect your feedback, constantly improve the quality of the game, and strive to bring you a more exciting game experience.

Thank you again to all the players for the support and love of Miss Peacock. We look forward to seeing everyone in the closed beta process and exploring the unique charm of "Miss Peacock."

The Otterclub team

2025.Jan.17
